input.quote: 15.11 Limitation of Liability. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT TO THE CONTRARY, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, RELIANCE OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES OR LOST OR IMPUTED PROFITS OR ROYALTIES OR COST OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES
input.rationale: Section 15.11 is the only limitation-of-liability provision; Article 12 (indemnification/insurance) and the Section 13.6 disclaimer contain no monetary limit, and no "aggregate liability" language appears anywhere. Section 15.11 delivers only the mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (plus a helpful mutual carve-out for speculative future sales and unachieved Article 6 milestones); it sets no aggregate monetary cap for either Party. The fallback requires a mutual cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs, so the absence of any cap fails the fallback on a material term and leaves PB's direct-damages exposure (including its broad Article 12 indemnities for clinical trial injury, product supply and third-party IP claims) unlimited. Redline inserts a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' payments between the Parties and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality/data security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and expressly preserves PB's Article 6 / Section 14.2 payment obligations outside the cap (consistent with the existing bargain and the playbook's "payment obligations are not damages" point). Basis wording is adapted to this co-development structure, which has no "fees".

ops.oldText: FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT WILL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AGGREGATE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY SUCH PARTY TO THE OTHER PARTY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION DOLLARS USD ($1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 10 (CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION) OR ANY DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATION, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OR MISAPPROPRIATION OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2, AND SUCH AMOUNTS WILL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO OR COUNTING AGAINST THE FOREGOING CAP.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 waives indirect damages but sets no aggregate monetary cap for either Party, so both of us are exposed without limit; our position is a mutual cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' payments and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and PB's Article 6 and Section 14.2 payment obligations are preserved and are not treated as capped damages.
proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs to Section 15.11, preserving PB's Article 6/14.2 payment obligations.
